verdict.rationale: The evidence shows generated Connect, gRPC and Protobuf clients for the Inference API. That implies an underlying schema exists, but no item documents that a user can download an OpenAPI or Protobuf spec file, and the probe found every candidate OpenAPI path returned 404. Generated client libraries are an adjacent artifact, not a downloadable machine-readable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
